nodes.description: Public boolean guard flag; set to true inside cast() to prevent the spell from being executed twice.
Constant human-readable description of the spell (Tinlake CF4 Mainnet Spell - 3).
Constant mainnet address of the Tinlake root contract that manages contract authorization.
Constant mainnet address of the NAV feed contract whose risk groups are configured.
Constant 10**27 fixed-point scaling factor used in the risk group rate parameters.
Storage address of this spell contract, used as the authorization target when calling relyContract.
Public entry point with no access control; requires the spell has not been cast, marks done, then runs execute().
Internal function that authorizes itself on the root contract and writes new risk group parameters into the NAV feed.
External privileged call that grants this spell contract write permissions over the NAV feed via the root contract.
External call setting risk groups 6-10 (risk, threshold, ceiling, rate, recovery rate) on the NAV feed.
Local interface handle TinlakeRootLike(address(ROOT)) used to call relyContract.
Local interface handle NAVFeedLike(address(NAV_FEED)) used to call file().

edges.reason: cast() reads and writes the done guard flag to enforce single execution.
cast() calls execute() after setting done = true.
execute() reads the constant ROOT address to build the root interface.
execute() reads the constant NAV_FEED address to build the navFeed interface.
execute() writes address(this) into the self state variable used for authorization.
execute() reads the constant ONE scaling factor when filing risk group parameters.
execute() assigns the local root handle from ROOT.
execute() assigns the local navFeed handle from NAV_FEED.
Unrestricted caller of cast() drives the local root handle into a privileged relyContract call that grants this spell write access over the NAV feed.
execute() invokes relyContract without any authorization check on the only public entry point cast().
The local navFeed handle is used to issue the file() calls that mutate risk group parameters.
execute() performs five external navFeed.file() risk group updates after gaining permissions.

normalization_plan.reason: Local interface handle root exists only to invoke root.relyContract(NAV_FEED, self); it carries no independent state and should be collapsed into that unsafe external operation.
Local interface handle navFeed exists only to invoke navFeed.file(riskGroup); it is a transient interface alias and should be collapsed into that unsafe external operation.
